description: Account menu with identity and actions provided by the application.

howToUse: Use it for the account of the person signed in: profile, settings and sign out.
Put it at the end of the top bar with `compact` (avatar only), or at the foot of the sidebar with `side="top"`, showing name and e-mail.
Change the items in `entries` and handle them in `onSelect`. Signing out is your application's job.

keyboard.action: Goes to the first or last item.
Closes the menu and returns focus to the button.

props.name: entries
props.description: Menu items. Default: Profile, Settings, ─, Sign out.

props.name: compact
props.description: Avatar only (topbar); default shows name + email (sidebar).

props.name: side
props.description: Menu opens above the trigger (sidebar footer).

props.name: align
props.description:
Menu edge aligned to the start or end of the trigger. Default: full width
in default mode; `end` in compact.
